methods.boundary_attribution: geoBoundaries / William & Mary geoLab; see boundary source metadata
methods.area_method: Lambert azimuthal equal-area, India-centred; clipped native cells; no sub-grid interpolation
methods.time_method: Monthly rain = pr × model-month days × 86400; Jun–Sep sums averaged across years. Temperature weighted by days within each year, then years averaged equally.
methods.scope: All retained India boundary area, not population, cropland, forest-only or station observations.
